title: eriogonum ochrocephalum var. agnellum
intro: Eriogonum ochrocephalum var. agnellum, commonly known as Agnus Castus or Chaste Tree, is a plant native to the southwestern United States and Mexico. It is a type of flowering shrub that belongs to the Polygonaceae family. The health benefits of Agnus Castus include its potential use in treating menstrual disorders, menopausal symptoms, and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, iridoids, and essential oils, that exhibit sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties.
